executive_summary: Your supplier risk is concentrated in two structural problems: China exposure (six critical and high-BAT suppliers across EMS, batteries, and nicotine) tied to US-China trade/Taiwan flashpoints, and a secondary cluster of geopolitical volatility in Eastern Europe, South Africa, and the India-Pakistan border affecting printing substrates and specialty materials. GPI's unexplained 3.4% stock drop warrants immediate outreach within 48 hours since it's your only non-geopolitical signal and high-BAT in printed packaging—this could be operational noise or early warning. The China suppliers (Huizhou BYD, Smoore, EVE Energy, Porton, IP Sun) represent your true urgency; if Taiwan tensions escalate or export controls tighten, you lose critical EMS and battery capacity simultaneously, so validate dual-sourcing timelines there now. Stora Enso and Sappi are yellow-flag substitutes for China printing substrates, but energy crisis in South Africa and proximity to Russia create their own 6-12 month headwinds—map secondary suppliers in EU/North America for these categories in parallel. ITC and Tae Young are lower priority unless India-Pakistan or Korea tensions spike; monitor but don't reallocate yet.
